entry.title: Nokia and Microsoft collaboration: Advancing AI, security and scale

media:group.media:title: Nokia and Microsoft collaboration: Advancing AI, security and scale
media:group.media:description:

entry.title: How Nokia and Red Hat are modernizing the mobile core's cloud infrastructure

media:group.media:title: How Nokia and Red Hat are modernizing the mobile core's cloud infrastructure
media:group.media:description:
As telecom networks become more cloud-native, operators face a critical challenge: how to modernize the mobile core while improving efficiency, resilience, and long-term flexibility. In this discussion, Jhuli Takahara of Nokia and Syed Khadeer Ahmed of Red Hat explore how their partnership is helping operators evolve from legacy virtualized environments to cloud-native infrastructure built on Red Hat OpenShift. They discuss migration strategies, operational automation, total cost of ownership, and the growing importance of common cloud platforms for telecom networks. Looking ahead, the conversation examines how AI, autonomous operations, and next-generation cloud architectures will shape the future of mobile core networks and create new opportunities for service providers.
Learn more about Nokia on Red Hat OpenShift: https://www.nokia.com/core-networks/nokia-on-red-hat-openshift/ Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/nokia-for-service-providers Follow us on X: https://x.com/nokianetworks

media:group.media:title: Automation at the Core with Vodafone shaping trusted AI and API driven services
media:group.media:description:
The talk explores how the core is evolving from a connectivity engine into a trusted, programmable and increasingly automated software platform, and how cloud native architecture, network APIs and AI can turn network capabilities into practical services without compromising security, resilience or operational control. Marcelo Madruga from Nokia joins Vodafone’s Beatriz Fernandez and Aitor Lorenzo to discuss how Nokia and Vodafone can bring these elements together for customers, enterprises and developers.

entry.title: Telefónica turns network exposure into an agentic platform for automation and monetization

media:group.media:title: Telefónica turns network exposure into an agentic platform for automation and monetization
media:group.media:description:
The conversation explores how Telefónica is evolving its network platform around automation, cloud native operations, GitOps, network exposure and agentic AI, with a clear focus on both efficiency and monetization. Marcelo Madruga from Nokia and Alexandre Harmand from Telefónica discuss how APIs, MCP and A2A can make network capabilities easier for developers and AI agents to consume, while opening new opportunities for B2B services. It also looks at IMS Data Channel as a way to bring new value to voice, starting with enterprise use cases and expanding as the wider device and application ecosystem matures.

entry.title: Reshaping the future of next-gen applications and mobility in 5G

media:group.media:title: Reshaping the future of next-gen applications and mobility in 5G
media:group.media:description:
Nokia’s 5G mobility solutions are enhancing network coverage and reliability in sectors such as transportation, industry, public safety, and digital experiences. Our innovations minimize service interruptions and deliver high performance, ensuring seamless handovers for high-velocity transport and reliable links for connected vehicles across cell boundaries. Network reliability is increased meeting the stringent requirements of mission-critical and industrial applications. For urban IoT environments, advanced mobility management provides assured connectivity for vast numbers of low-energy devices, including sensors and wearables, supporting diverse use cases like health monitoring and environmental sensing.
Find out more: www.nokia.com/licensing/innovations

entry.title: Vodafone Albania and Nokia showcase the future of intelligent 5G networks

media:group.media:title: Vodafone Albania and Nokia showcase the future of intelligent 5G networks
media:group.media:description:
Vodafone Albania and Nokia demonstrated one of the first AI-powered network slicing solutions within the Vodafone Group, combining a 5G Standalone (5G SA) network with advanced artificial intelligence to create a more intelligent, automated, and adaptive connectivity experience.
In this video, Balázs Révész, CEO of Vodafone Albania, explains how the demonstration showcases AI's ability to analyze both network conditions and real-world information in real time, enabling autonomous decisions that instantly optimize network performance. Instead of relying on predefined configurations, the network can dynamically allocate resources where they are needed most, helping deliver more efficient, resilient, and differentiated connectivity.
Watch how Vodafone Albania and Nokia are helping lay the foundations for the next generation of intelligent 5G networks.
Learn more about Network slicing: https://www.nokia.com/network-slicing/ Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/nokia-for-service-providers/ Follow us on X: https://x.com/nokianetworks
